title: Grateful Dead Live at Public Hall on 1973-12-06
lineage: CD > Wav > Sound Forge 9 for compression, volume and EQ  > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a lo‑fi ’73 show highlighted by a soaring Here Comes Sunshine and a massive Dark Star
ai_review.review: The remastered soundboard capture is praised as louder, cleaner and “golden,” delivering a warm yet crisp mix that lets every instrument shine. Musically the night shines on Here Comes Sunshine, a sprawling Dark Star and tight jams like China‑Rider, while some listeners find the first set a bit sluggish. Overall the performance is considered a fun, laid‑back classic of the 1973 era.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star, extolling both performance and recording quality; only one moderate 3‑star review tempers the consensus, yielding a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as louder, cleaner, crisp, warm and “golden”; no dropouts or major flaws noted, just a pleasant crunchy character that adds vintage charm.

poor_songs: Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is viewed as a standard, slightly under‑driven collection of tunes, while the second set relaxes into expansive jams and highlights (HCS, Dark Star, China Rider) that define the night’s energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone and lyrical phrasing are repeatedly praised; his string bends on Here Comes Sunshine and his interplay with Bob are called “magnificent.”
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh is noted for giving the Dark Star a boost early on and generally “bringing it” alongside Keith.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s rhythm work meshes tightly with Garcia, providing strong support throughout the jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux’s playing is highlighted as a standout element—sometimes even outshining Garcia (e.g., on Deal & Greatest Story Ever Told).
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart’s drumming is mentioned in passing as solid and energetic, contributing to the overall fun vibe of the show.
